messages:
Sam (PM): idea: run a staggered mini-cohort DP pilot (3 waves of 2 partners) to test onboarding friction, feature gating, and rollout triggers. goal: surface rollback criteria before scaling. thoughts?
Maya - Product Ops: love it. waves let us measure marginal onboarding cost and churn. propose wave cadence = 2 weeks per wave (onboard + 2-week observation).
Ethan Eng: technical ask: we need a config in console to opt partners into 'cohort-mode' so we can flip routing + telemetry for only DP traffic. estimate 1 sprint.
Ruth (CS): to reduce noise, each partner should pick 1 primary use-case and 2 success queries. we'll evaluate quality + latency on those. also require a single integration owner on partner side.
Sam (PM): agree. success metrics per partner = activation (end-to-end call), SLO compliance (p90 latency), and qualitative CS score at week 4. also track setup time (hours).
Alex (Legal): for cohort pilot, propose a short "participation addendum" rather than full NDA — simple data handling terms, 30d logs, anonymized test data, and a clause for a joint case study if both agree.
Ruth (CS): recruitment note: prefer customers already in POC stage. they convert faster and can commit an integration owner.
devrel-team: created draft intake sheet: https://forms.redwood.com/dp-mini-cohort (fields: company, contact, use-case, dataset type, production intent, case-study OK).
Maya - Product Ops: onboarding checklist draft: 1) intake verified, 2) pre-screen call (30m), 3) ephemeral api key + sandbox route, 4) integration runbook, 5) weekly feedback form. will share.
Ethan Eng: rollback plan: default fallback = route DP traffic to hosted baseline model if errors exceed threshold. need feature flag + health metrics feed. suggest thresholds: error rate >5% for 15m or latency p95 >1s above baseline for 15m.
Sam (PM): good thresholds. add manual rollback trigger for product ops if qualitative reports indicate misalignment.
Alex (Legal): confirm data disposal protocol: ephemeral keys expire at 30d, logs auto-purge at 45d, partner can request early deletion. I'll draft language.
Ruth (CS): recommend weekly short survey for partners (3 questions) + one structured interview at week 4. captures sentiment + integration blockers.
Maya - Product Ops: timeline proposal: announce recruitment Mon, 10 business-day intake window, select 6 partners, wave 1 onboard start in 3 weeks.
Sam (PM): incentives: $3k credits + 8 hours of eng support + spotlight in partner stories. adjust if partner needs heavier usage.
Ethan Eng: resource commit: we can dedicate 6 eng-hours/wave for onboarding triage. if partner requests custom infra changes, escalate to eng-schedule.
Ruth (CS): success/fail criteria per wave: success if >=1 partner reaches activation + positive CS score; fail if both partners drop or report showstopper.
Maya - Product Ops: metrics dashboard items: onboarding hours, activation time, p90/p95 latency vs baseline, error rate, weekly CS score, trial conversion intent.
Sam (PM): next steps: Maya to publish intake + checklist, Alex to share draft addendum, Ethan to scope console flag work, Ruth to prepare weekly survey. we'll sync next Tue to confirm slots.
devrel-team: posting announce draft for targeted accounts: "Mini-cohort DP pilot - focused integration help + credits". will share copy for review.
Sam (PM): thanks team — aiming to learn rollout safety and scale signals before larger beta. short & focused. :rocket:
